overall_status: UNTESTED: the seven-case post-call projection (needrebuild and irreduciblecount results, preorder fed to findIrreducible, final rootlist, reordered component list, per-block index/visitcount/numdesc/mark/copymap collapse state, and both edge-half label classifications including f_irreducible) byte-matches the locked oracle for the standalone findSpanningTree+findIrreducible path and the structureLoops driver on a reducible graph; calcLoop's body remains a registered no-op stub and no production caller consumes structure_loops yet
architecture: locked synthetic plain FlowBlock graphs built through production BlockGraph::newBlock/addEdge; no AddrSpace, no Funcdata, no PcodeOps (findIrreducible touches only blocks, edges, copymap/mark/visitcount/numdesc scalar state)
compiler_spec: not applicable: no Funcdata, no prototype model, no symbols (pure BlockGraph fixture)

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of locked BlockGraph::findSpanningTree followed by BlockGraph::findIrreducible (six cases) or the full BlockGraph::structureLoops driver (one reducible case) on synthetic component graphs built through production BlockGraph APIs (newBlock/addEdge); no Actions, SSA, or C emission
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh BlockGraph with all-same-block edges added in a fixed order; no pre-corrupted state is needed (findSpanningTree's pass-start wipe re-initializes index/visitcount/copymap/numdesc/labels, established by BLOCK-INDEX-ASSIGN-0001)
analysis_options.observation: Per case: findIrreducible's needrebuild return and irreduciblecount out-param (dashes for the structureLoops case where both are driver-internal), the preorder vector exactly as fed to findIrreducible, final rootlist, final component list order, per-block index/visitcount/numdesc/mark/copymap (self/other:name/null — the FIND-structure collapse state), and every out-edge slot->target plus mirrored in-edge slot<source with semantic label letters (g l d i t f c b x, '-' when unlabeled)
analysis_options.normalization: Block identity prints as creation-order names (b0..bn), never pointers. Edge labels print as semantic flag-set membership letters, not raw bits: Rugra's edge_flags bit assignments intentionally differ from Ghidra's (documented remap in src/block.rs edge_flags), and Rugra's F_TREE_EDGE shares bit 7 with F_DEFAULTSWITCH_EDGE (pre-existing EDGEFLAG-BIT7-COLLISION-0001); within this projection bit 7 is classified as tree because findSpanningTree wipes every label at each pass start and neither pass sets default-switch labels. The structureLoops case prints rebuild=- and cnt=- because the driver's local needrebuild/irreduciblecount never escape the call.

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: reducible_diamond_zero_marks: single-entry diamond plus bypass; no back edges, every reachunder set stays empty, irreduciblecount stays 0 (block.cc:1157-1163)
self_loop_head_skipped: self back edge b1->b1 has y == x so the loop head never seeds its own reachunder set (block.cc:1160); zero marks

classic_two_entry: entries from b0 into both sides of the b1<->b2 cycle; the forward edge b0!1->b2 fails the interval test, is labeled f_irreducible, its forward classification cleared (block.cc:1174-1182), and b2 collapses into the loop head b1 (copymap projection)

parallel_edges_double_count: duplicate b0->b0->b2 edges seed the reachunder set twice with no dedup (block.cc:1161) so the BFS re-scans the member and irreduciblecount accumulates 2; both out slots labeled i

nested_irreducible_find_reuse: irreducible pair {b2,b3} inside the outer b1 loop; x=b2's pass collapses b3 into b2 and the later x=b1 pass observes FIND(b3)=b2 (copymap reuse, block.cc:1161/1173/1194); final copymap shows the collapse chain b3->other:b2, b2/b4->other:b1
multi_root_cross_to_irreducible: roots b0,b1 with the rootlist head/tail swap; b0's later cross edge into the other root's loop body is promoted to irreducible (cross classification cleared)

structure_loops_reducible_endtoend: full driver (block.cc:2194-2215) on a reducible loop nest: single pass, no rebuild, irreduciblecount==0 so calcLoop is never reached; back|loop labels and the copymap collapse state projected post-call

observation_schema.format: Eight fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope plus seven case records
observation_schema.state: per-block index (reverse post order), visitcount (preorder number), numdesc, mark (always 0 after the collapse clear), copymap identity (self vs collapsed-to loop head)
observation_schema.graph: preorder vector as fed to findIrreducible, final rootlist, final list order, per-slot out-edge and mirrored in-edge label classification, needrebuild/irreduciblecount results

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-block-findirred-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

build.cpp_oracle: The complete decompiler C++ subtree is exported from the locked commit into a fresh temporary directory and libdecomp.a is rebuilt there before the fixture is linked; no live worktree archive is consumed
build.private_state_observer: Read-only ABI observation of FlowBlock scalar fields (index/visitcount/numdesc/copymap/flags mark bit) and both BlockEdge halves through #define private public and #define class struct (BlockGraph helper members are implicitly private without an access label) in the fixture translation unit only; no oracle source is modified
build.rust_comparand: A SHA-256-pinned full Rust crate snapshot is materialized from the pinned Rugra Git base 296c128 with only src/block.rs overlaid; every registry archive is checked against Cargo.lock, safely expanded to a private vendor tree, and used through a private CARGO_HOME
build.environment_policy: Runner re-executes from an open file descriptor under an empty environment, verifies fixed toolchain/oracle/base identities, snapshots every mutable input, rebuilds the oracle archive, runs Cargo locked+offline against only the checksum-verified vendor tree, compares exact bytes, then hashes all owned inputs and the full Rust snapshot again

coverage.reducible_zero_marks: MATCH: diamond plus bypass produces no back edges, empty reachunder sets, and irreduciblecount 0 (block.cc:1157-1163)
coverage.self_loop_head_exclusion: MATCH: the self back edge b1->b1 is skipped by the y == x guard (block.cc:1160) and no edge is labeled irreducible
coverage.back_edge_pair_promotion_forward: MATCH: classic two-entry cycle labels the forward entry edge f_irreducible, clears its forward classification on both halves (block.cc:1178-1182), and collapses the non-head side into the loop head
coverage.parallel_edge_double_count: MATCH: reachunder seeding has no dedup (block.cc:1161-1162) so the duplicate member is re-scanned and irreduciblecount accumulates once per parallel edge (2)
coverage.nested_find_reuse_collapse: MATCH: inner x=b2 collapse is observed by the outer x=b1 pass as FIND(b3)=b2 (block.cc:1161/1173 reads of copymap written at block.cc:1194); the final copymap projection shows the b3->other:b2, b2/b4->other:b1 chain
coverage.multi_root_cross_promotion: MATCH: with two roots the swapped root scan order makes the later root's cross edge into the first root's loop body irreducible (cross classification cleared)
coverage.structure_loops_driver_wiring: MATCH: full driver on a reducible loop nest runs one findSpanningTree+findIrreducible iteration with no rebuild and irreduciblecount 0 (calcLoop not reached); labels and collapse state match
coverage.copymap_collapse_projection: MATCH: every case's final copymap shows self for heads/outsiders and other:<head> for collapsed members with all marks cleared
coverage.mark_cleared_projection: MATCH: mark=0 on every block after every case (the collapse loop clears each member, block.cc:1193)
coverage.irreducible_tree_edge_rebuild: UNTESTED: needrebuild=true requires a TREE edge to fail the interval test (block.cc:1174-1180); exhaustive enumeration through the locked oracle found zero occurrences across all 65536 four-node digraphs (with self-loops; 24000 irreducible) and all 1048576 five-node digraphs (no self-loops; 730112 irreducible), consistent with the interval-nesting argument (a reachunder member's tree parent cannot be both a proper DFS ancestor of x and satisfy the interval containment), so the branch is defensive in the locked oracle and not reachable from constructible fresh spanning trees
coverage.is_irreducible_in_skip: UNTESTED: the reachunder in-edge skip (block.cc:1170) fires only for edges already labeled f_irreducible within a single findIrreducible call; the seeding loop never labels before the BFS of the same x, and multi-x reuse only reads (never labels) earlier edges during a later x's walk, so no constructible single-call input reaches it (needs a second findIrreducible call over the same labels without an intervening findSpanningTree wipe, which structureLoops never performs)
coverage.calc_loop_body: UNTESTED: calcLoop (block.cc:2104-2147) is a registered no-op stub; any structureLoops run with irreduciblecount > 0 would additionally label cycle-breaking f_loop_edge edges on the oracle side, so irreducible end-to-end driver cases are excluded and this remains a separate task (suggested BLOCK-CALCLOOP-0001)
coverage.production_pipeline_wiring: UNTESTED: no production caller invokes BlockGraph::structure_loops yet (blockaction.rs has no structureReset-equivalent call site); migrating the structurer onto the driver requires a pipeline differential gate
coverage.edgeflag_bit7_collision: UNTESTED: pre-existing EDGEFLAG-BIT7-COLLISION-0001 (F_TREE_EDGE and F_DEFAULTSWITCH_EDGE share bit 7) is not exercised because no default-switch labels coexist with tree labels in this domain (wipe-first); reallocation is a separate audited task
